body:
The selected PR589 R439 word spends 18,085 additions on frame-zero dirty-helper compensation. A **306-step restored target basis** reduces that prefix to **6,988 ADDs**, including every preparation and restoration gate. The complete native word falls **24,305 → 13,208**, saving **11,097 additions**. **Finite bit-supplier construction; no new κ.**

| Quantity | PR589 baseline | Candidate |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| D target preparation / restoration | 0 / 0 | 306 / 306 |
| D helper injections | 18,085 | 6,376 |
| Complete D ADDs | **18,085** | **6,988** |
| Complete native ADDs | **24,305** | **13,208** |
| Forward positive bound | 49,347 | 49,347 |
| Reverse positive bound | 1,113,070 | 9,534,616 |
| Local payload bits / ceiling | 93 / 104 | 100 / 104 |
| Nine-stage prefix bits / charge | 177 / 192 | 189 / 192 |

All 439 helpers, nine copies, paid rank mass 5,129, register frame paths and every non-D field are retained. For the original binary matrix K, D computes `E^-1(Ey + EKs) = y + Ks` for **arbitrary incoming targets and helpers**. No source or helper is written during D.

**Required interface change:** the original gate-local H2 and its direct K extractor reject target mixing. Both false predicates are recorded explicitly, with the predecessor checker unchanged. This package proves and independently checks the established semantic D-boundary substitute; H1/H3/H4/H5, every other source conclusion, complete geometry, legality and full arbitrary-dirt endpoint pass. Maintainer acceptance and supplier source binding of that semantic contract are integration obligations.

The reverse bound increases and is explicitly priced. The source nine-stage formula `2^18 F^5 B^4` gives **189 bits**, within its existing 192-bit prefix charge. Its AST, bridge exponent and baseline receipt are pinned and checked. This does not certify unchanged complete hosted invoices or other allocations, and no full changed-word hosted/outer reconstruction or new exponent is claimed.

Reproduce with Python 3.12+, a C++17 compiler and Boost headers:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-target-compensation/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/r439-target-compensation/test_package.py -v
```

- Full replay passes on **CPython 3.14.4** and an **isolated optimized CPython 3.12.3 read-only minimal closure with spaces in its path**, with identical complete receipts.
- Independent set-valued reconstruction; **9,643,960 literal positive instructions** checking both orders of all **306 accepted partial words**; **661 separate Boolean input columns** of both D words in both directions.
- Fresh unchanged C++ legality and 5/9/11-stage checks for both complete words: **883 / 1,327 / 1,549 columns**, **96 omitted-bridge controls** rejected, identical MOVE/COPY/ERASE paths and paid ranks.
- **14 local controls**, one paid neutral-pair control and **eight package tests** pass. Omitting the entire entrance passes helper-only tests but fails arbitrary-target columns. Regenerated gzip is compared by every decoded field. All 14 immutable main inputs match base Git objects; the retained predecessor proof matches its exact API Git blob.

Seed **10** selects this distinct D task. The bounded search scores **3,748,470 ordered pairs** over 307 iterations, including the terminal iteration; no bound guard rejects a nominee in this run. The independent final 12,210-pair census has maximum additional paid single-shear gain zero. This certifies the stated local stopping rule, not global optimality or a search through neutral detours/combined row-column operations.

**Credit:** commdata2338's **PR794** for guarded target-basis nomination and its exact incremental positive-vector formula on historical R420; **Scott Woolsey Biggart PR713 / Sagar Thakrar PR716** for target-pair constructions; **Mikhail R. Gadelha PR686 / Greer Guthrie PR694** for semantic D-boundary/helper-basis work. The PR794 proof is retained verbatim at its exact head. This contribution applies the method to the selected punctured R439 matrix and supplies the actual reduction and full accepted-step literal checks; no mechanism-priority claim is made.

The word is **DreamingOfClouds's PR589 tuning of eumemic's PR555/543**. Native source/harness and inherited construction contributors are credited in NOTICE.md. **navinor PR848** identifies the R439 H2 barrier under the old syntax; this submission explicitly changes that contract. PR904 and newer R439 block proposals #906/#908 change A/B and leave D unchanged; no combined saving is certified.

Only `research/r439-target-compensation/` is added, against refreshed base **f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631**. Claim, exact source pins, proof, recipe/candidate, full expected receipt, validation and licenses are included. The selected #799 κ remains **0.001661634653669567**, with the other assumptions stated in the [maintainer review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631/docs/research/community-frontier799-review.md). Integrating this candidate requires the semantic D boundary and complete updated hosted invoice described above. No repository-wide suite, selected cold replay, full multiplication formalization or measured runtime speedup is claimed. Hosted CI is reported separately after publication.

Prepared for **Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**. One AI agent performed the work; no independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0.

Published head: **e9daefe320a0043000bd9746664ed02c3287d056**. Tested mathematical code and artifacts are at **7d5ef1dcf994d0542f2d302110b33780f5504ab7**; the final commit records the result/link and clarifies scope wording. Remote head, OPEN state and all 16 changed paths match the local checkout. All five hosted workflows report **action_required**, awaiting maintainer approval; no hosted pass is claimed. [Research artifact workflow](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38396711837).
title: Bit supplier: save 11,097 R439 ADDs with guarded target-basis compensation (no new kappa)
